summary.text: Maureen Madden is the Democratic incumbent, in office since December 1, 2016, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 115, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Maureen Madden assumed office on December 1, 2016.

Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Education (subcommittee chair on Career and Technical Education), Gaming Oversight (vice chair), Human Services (subcommittee chair on Mental Health), and State Government (secretary and subcommittee chair on Campaign Finance and Elections).
